notes:
- Prospect: trading platform that surfaces live market insights and a trader chat assistant. Extremely latency-sensitive and cost conscious.
- Wants sub-250ms tail latency for chat replies at peak load (200 concurrent traders), target 99th pct < 250ms end-to-end.
- Throughput goal: sustained 300 reqs/sec with spikes to 1k reqs/sec during market open.
- Primary model preference: quantized 13B-style family (q4/q5) or distilled variant; willing to evaluate 7B for cost-critical flows.
- Key optimization interests: batching strategy (continuous batching vs fixed windows), KV/cache reuse across sessions, prefix caching for repeated context, and aggressive quantization profiles. Also wants benchmarking harness to reproduce production traffic shape.
- Security: VPC + customer KMS, SSO/SAML, audit logs retained 1 year, data residency in us-east region for trading data.
- Quote from CTO on call: "If the 99p slips past 250ms during open, traders drop it — latency is directly revenue-impacting."
- Risk: internal legal has strict audit controls; procurement timeline ~6 weeks after POC.
- Interested in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching and quantization and an automated perf report comparing latency/cost tradeoffs.
